description: Extend the Alert model with new columns (pest_name, source_report_id, affected_report_count, resolved_by_user_id, resolved_at) and add HIGH/MEDIUM values to AlertSeverity. Add outbreak config settings to Settings. Add app/schemas/outbreak.py with Pydantic v2 response schemas. These are the foundational data-layer and schema changes all other FEATs depend on.
steps: Step 1 — app/models/alert.py: Add HIGH and MEDIUM to AlertSeverity enum (keeping INFO/WARNING/CRITICAL so existing test_models.py creating AlertSeverity.CRITICAL still works). Add five new nullable columns to Alert: pest_name = Column(String(128), nullable=True, index=True); source_report_id = Column(Integer, ForeignKey('crop_reports.id', ondelete='SET NULL'), nullable=True, index=True); affected_report_count = Column(Integer, default=1, nullable=False); resolved_by_user_id = Column(Integer, ForeignKey('users.id', ondelete='SET NULL'), nullable=True); resolved_at = Column(DateTime(timezone=True), nullable=True). Add the SQLAlchemy DateTime import if not already present (it is already imported). Add a 'source_report' relationship: source_report = relationship('CropReport', foreign_keys=[source_report_id]).

Step 2 — app/models/__init__.py: Export the two new AlertSeverity values by ensuring AlertSeverity is already in __all__ (it is — no change needed there, but verify). No other __init__ change needed since Alert is already exported.

Step 3 — app/core/config.py: Add three new settings fields to the Settings class: OUTBREAK_RADIUS_KM: float = 10.0; OUTBREAK_MIN_REPORTS: int = 2; ALERT_COOLDOWN_HOURS: int = 24. Place them in a clearly commented 'Outbreak Detection' block.

Step 4 — app/schemas/outbreak.py: Create this new file with Pydantic v2 models. All models use model_config = ConfigDict(from_attributes=True). Define: (a) AlertResponse — id: int, title_en: str (max_length=128), title_rw: str (max_length=128), pest_name: Optional[str], target_district: str, target_sector: Optional[str], severity: str, status: str, affected_report_count: int = 1, source_report_id: Optional[int], created_at: datetime. (b) AlertDetailResponse — extends AlertResponse, adds message_en: str, message_rw: str, resolved_by_user_id: Optional[int], resolved_at: Optional[datetime]. (c) RiskScoreResponse — district: str, pest_name: Optional[str], crop_id: Optional[int], risk_score: float = Field(ge=0.0, le=1.0), contributing_report_count: int = Field(ge=0), threshold: float = Field(ge=0.0, le=1.0), above_threshold: bool. (d) OutbreakCheckRequest — report_id: int = Field(ge=1). (e) AlertListQueryParams — not a schema, handled by Query() params directly in the router.
acceptance_criteria: python -m pytest tests/test_models.py -v passes (the existing Alert creation with AlertSeverity.CRITICAL still works)

python -c "from app.schemas.outbreak import AlertResponse, AlertDetailResponse, RiskScoreResponse, OutbreakCheckRequest; print('OK')" prints 'OK' without error
